draft_en.subject: Is Nextlan still in network distribution? Two numbers if yes
draft_en.body:
Hello Nextlan team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 1 October 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Your old web address now points to an accounting firm, so first the honest question: is Nextlan still active in network distribution? If yes, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5.

One question: if you are still distributing, which port count do your customers ask for most?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
